title: Read-only reentrancy: the pending* views report FULL pending for value already delivered during the caller-side-realignment window, via an owner-selected hooked (ERC777-class) promo token
description: State-changing reentrancy is FULLY CLOSED (OZ ReentrancyGuard is contract-wide; every value-handling entry point carries nonReentrant). Only the read-only view leg survives: debt realignment is caller-side (:715-717, :761-763, :808-810), so the pending views (pendingPhUSD :993, pendingStable :1014, pendingPromo :1040) report FULL pending for value already delivered during a callback originating inside _claimRewards. PhlimboV3's OWN accounting remains correct throughout.
impact: A hypothetical downstream integrator double-counts. NO value at risk inside PhlimboV3.
attackPath: Requires TWO unestablished preconditions to coincide:
(1) the owner selects a hooked (ERC777-class) promo token, AND
(2) a downstream integrator treats the pending views as an entitlement oracle.
No such integrator exists in scope. Harm lands OUTSIDE PhlimboV3.
recommendation: Token-curation policy note: extend the promo-token curation already performed at startPromotion:401 (which explicitly rejects fee-on-transfer) to also reject hooked/ERC777-class tokens. Alternatively realign debt BEFORE the transfer, or document that the pending* views are not reentrancy-safe oracles.

SEVERITY_DISAGREEMENT_IN_BAND.recorded: Deliberately recorded in-band rather than silently picking a side.

validityChecker.verdict: QUESTIONED -- RETAIN but RECOMMEND DOWNGRADE Low -> QA, reframed as a token-curation policy note.
reasoning: NON-STANDARD TOKEN (detected, load-bearing): precondition 1 is 'the owner selects a hooked (ERC777-class) promo token'. ERC777 is the archetypal weird ERC-20 on every weird-erc20 list and C4 rules it invalid by default. Without a hooked token there is no callback, no window, no finding -- the non-standard token is not incidental colour, it is load-bearing on the trigger.

UNUSED VIEW (detected): the C4 rule 'unused view functions are QA at best' applies with unusual directness, since the entire impact runs THROUGH views that no in-scope contract consumes. By the rule's own words this caps at QA.
SPECULATION / NO DEMONSTRATED IMPACT (detected): 'the harmed party does not exist' -- the finding concedes 'None identified in scope.' The window is real; the victim is hypothetical.

The footgun's non-obviousness is WEAKER than the classifier allows: ERC777 reentrancy hazards are among the most publicized in DeFi (imBTC/Uniswap, Lendf.me), so a competent operator is closer to 'should know' than 'has no reason to expect'.
validityChecker.butRetain: Do NOT drop (Law 1: an uncleared reentrancy row is a recall risk, and the window is real).

DURABLE_RULE_FoT: Verified in source at src/PhlimboV3.sol:401: `require(IERC20(token).balanceOf(address(this)) - balanceBefore == amount, "Fee-on-transfer not supported");` in startPromotion. CONSEQUENCE: any FUTURE fee-on-transfer finding against phlimbo-ea is INVALID -- the protocol guards it explicitly. This CONFIRMS run-07's decision to DROP its L-04 (FoT) as known-invalid was correct. It also cuts the other way for THIS finding: the protocol demonstrably CURATES promo tokens for weirdness in this exact function, which is why a hook-curation gap in the same function is a coherent policy note rather than pure token-blaming -- and is what rescues it from outright INVALID.
